movelist.name: Agility
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Speed 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Hex
movelist.effect: Once a Scene, if Hex’s target has a Status Affliction, you may have Hex’s Damage Base be 13 instead (4d10+10 / 35).

movelist.name: Assurance
movelist.effect: When you hit with Assurance, if Assurance’s target has already been damaged by a Move on the same round Assurance is being used, Assurance has a Damage Base of 12 (3d12+10 / 30) instead. This effect may trigger only once per Scene per Target.

movelist.name: Lock-On
movelist.effect: The target is Locked-On. The next Move that the user uses against the Target that requires an Accuracy Check cannot miss. Lock-On’s effect, on both the User and Target, is passed on by Baton Pass.

abilities.name: Cursed Body
abilities.trigger: The user is hit by a Damaging Move.

abilities.name: Friend Guard
abilities.effect: The damage is resisted one step further. Defensive.
